about_the_game:
In "Divine Quest," you become the last guardian of the Holy Land, fighting against heretics that surge forth like waves. Up to 4 Crusader knights unite as one to defend sacred ground, achieving victory in seemingly impossible battles through cooperation and strategy!

Holy Crusaders, But the Truth Runs Darker

The untold truth of history is finally revealed. What we knew as the Black Death was no mere plague—it was a cursed catastrophe where the dead rose to devour the living. The Holy City of Jerusalem has already become a land of the damned, and only the last remaining Crusader knights stand as humanity's final hope.

A Desperate Journey Through the Holy Grail

Only the sacred Holy Grail can end this curse. But the path to reach it is flooded with endless waves of the undead. Rotting corpses crawl from their graves, once-holy churches have become lairs of the damned, and instead of sacred prayers echoing through the halls, only the groans of the dead fill the air.

The Desolate World of Medieval Post-Apocalypse

In the collapsed civilization of medieval Europe, survivors dwindle while the dead multiply endlessly. Once-prosperous cities lie in ruins, and beyond the walls stretches an endless procession of zombies. Even the sacred cross proves powerless against these abominations—only steel, faith, and the bonds between comrades offer any hope of survival.

The Last Stand of the Faithful

Knights of different sacred callings forge a final alliance. In battles against the undead, each warrior's unique abilities shine through, but only perfect teamwork can ensure survival in this hellish reality.

Divine Rapture - God's Final Blessing

In moments of despair, when the knights' faith unites as one, the true power of the Holy Grail awakens. This is the last miracle that can purify the undead and grant new hope to the living. But to receive this blessing requires perfect cooperation and unwavering faith.

Relentless Battle Against Endless Zombie Hordes

Each wave brings forth more powerful and terrifying undead. From common shambling corpses to armored death knights and massive rotting giants—diverse horrors test your faith and swordsmanship. Every enemy demands different tactics, and a single mistake can lead to total annihilation.

Hope Rising from Growing Darkness

Use Crusade Points earned through combat to strengthen your knights and acquire new holy weapons and blessings. As the undead grow stronger, you too will gain more powerful divine abilities. But true strength comes from trust and cooperation with your companions.

This is not mere survival—it's a sacred mission to preserve humanity's last hope. Will you reach the Holy Grail and redeem this cursed world? Or will you too become one with the legion of the damned?
